senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Loose, lax, flaccid, flabby.
2 Languid, inert, feeble.
3 Ineffective, unenergetic.
4 Relaxed, slackened.
5 Not rigidly observed.
6 Loosely retained or possessed.
7 Abandoned, got rid of, shaken off.
E.
श्रथ to be lax or loose, Uṇādi aff. किरच्, the form irr.

f. (-ता)
Relaxation, looseness, being unfastened, &c.
E.
शिथिल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिथिलत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Let go, loosed, released.
2 Relaxed, loosened.
E.
शिथिल, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Weakened, relaxed.
E.
शिथिल, and बल strength.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
1 Reduced in wealth.
2 Shining with diminished rays.
E.
शिथिल, and वसु wealth, &c.

mfn. (-क्तिः-शिः-क्ति)
Impaired in strength or power.
E.
शिथिल, and शक्ति power.

n. (-णं)
1 Loosening, unfastening.
2 Impairing, weakening, reducing.
E.
शिथिल, and करण doing, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unbound, unfastened. slackened.
2 Reduced, impaired, weakened.
3 Let loose.
E.
शिथिल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
